t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background inside a thin inset hairline frame. Uppercase eyebrow, an oversized light-weight navy sans headline and a two-line subhead at top-left. Centre-right: one matte white polypropylene skid with translucent pale-blue water columns, soft 3D isometric render in even studio light. Numbered callouts on both sides, steel-blue mono numbers, uppercase titles and short notes for <CONTENT>, joined to the skid by hairline leaders. Tiny mono codes in the bottom corners. Calm, square.
signature_idea: The audit pack's parts hang off one soft white skid as numbered callouts, so the documents read as describing that real system.
strengths: one clear object with balanced numbered callouts is easy to scan
steel-blue mono numbers are the single accent, as the brand asks
oversized light headline and limestone space are on-brand
soft white PP render shows the actual material
weaknesses: callouts point at arbitrary parts; documents are not physical components
skid detail (cabinets, columns) is generic rather than Aquemi equipment
corner codes are invented file and date codes
callout titles in uppercase are louder than the light headline
brand_fit_why: Limestone space, light navy headline, steel-blue mono numbers, hairline leaders and a white PP render are the brand book closely.
